command: test -f "$GRID_HOME"/projects/notes-app/tasks/T-01-release-note/artifacts/release-note.md && printf '%s\n' 'Notes can now be searched by tag.' 'Type a tag in the search box to filter the list.' | cmp - "$GRID_HOME"/projects/notes-app/tasks/T-01-release-note/artifacts/release-note.md

test -f "$GRID_HOME"/projects/notes-app/tasks/T-01-release-note/intent.md && printf '%s\n' 'write a two-line release note for the new tag search' | cmp - "$GRID_HOME"/projects/notes-app/tasks/T-01-release-note/intent.md

test -f "$GRID_HOME"/projects/notes-app/tasks/T-01-release-note/history.md && ! grep -Eq 'plan accepted|preview approved|ship approved|phase set' "$GRID_HOME"/projects/notes-app/tasks/T-01-release-note/history.md
grep -Eq '^Notes can now be searched by tag\.$' work/notes-app/docs/release-note.md
